title: I'm making a fast-paced 2D action game with AI-assisted coding and art — here's my free prototype!
author: C-damaGameStudio
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I'm a solo indie developer from Japan, working on a fast-paced 2D action platformer called Ghost truck.

The core mechanic is simple: dash into enemies to steal their weapons, keep moving, and parry incoming attacks to survive.

My goal is to create fast, satisfying combat that feels great to play.

I started development 14 days ago and recently released a free playable prototype on itch.io.

How I'm using AI in development:

I'm using Codex to help develop the game in Godot, along with generative AI to create some of the visual assets.

I handle the game design, mechanics, creative decisions, and playtesting myself. AI has helped me turn my ideas into a playable prototype much faster than I could have otherwise.

One thing that worked particularly well was implementing visual effects like slow motion and afterimages. With AI-assisted coding, I was able to add and iterate on these effects quickly.

On the other hand, generating pixel art animations has been challenging. Getting consistent, natural-looking frames is harder than I expected, so I'm considering drawing some of the animations by hand as development continues.

About the prototype:

\- Free to play on Windows

\- Controller and keyboard/mouse support

\- English and Japanese language options

\- Still in early development

Note for English-speaking players: The game starts in Japanese. You can switch to English in "オプション" →"言語" using D/right inputs.

Play Ghost truck here:

[https://c-dama-game-studio.itch.io/ghost-truck](https://c-dama-game-studio.itch.io/ghost-truck)

I'm also curious how other solo developers are using AI in their workflows. Are you using it mainly for coding, art, or both?

And if you try the prototype, I'd love to hear what you think of the combat!

Thanks for checking it out!

comments.author: ASAF12341
comments.body: Why put the hero as blue ghost or somthing?

replies.author: C-damaGameStudio
replies.body:
I added blue effects to make the main character stand out against the dark backgrounds and make his movements easier to follow.

As for the ghost-like appearance, I'm guessing you mean his hidden face? I wanted to give him a mysterious look!

What kind of design would you prefer? I'd love to hear your thoughts!

replies.author: ASAF12341
replies.body: It is out of character for the game; I would just give the hero more time in design so that they will look unique.

replies.author: C-damaGameStudio
replies.body:
Yeah, I agree that the main character's sprite still needs some work, so I'll keep improving it.

Thanks for the feedback!
